name: Banque Cantonale de Genève SA
summary: Banque Cantonale de Genève SA, together with its subsidiaries, provides a range of banking services in Switzerland and internationally. The company operates through three main business divisions: Individuals & Digital Banking, Corporate Banking & Trade Finance, and Wealth & Asset Management. The Individuals & Digital Banking division manages a network of agencies and provides retail banking products, including current and savings accounts, mortgages, personal loans, payment cards, and digital banking services.
